title: Branch and conflict signalling
goal: Relay-side handling of branch.update and conflict.detected so members learn about branch divergence and overlapping work from metadata, without the relay seeing branch names or paths.
scope_in: Pass-through sequencing for branch.update (encrypted-only) with per-agent rate limit of 1 frame per 2 s (latest wins) and size limit 192 KiB on ct.
Handler for conflict.detected (hybrid) validating p.agent_ids against the agent registry and p.path_hmacs against the lock store, with de-dup of identical (agent_ids, path_hmacs) sets within 30 s.

Server-side conflict detection from lock denials (from B059 port): when a deny occurs for path_hmac P, emit conflict.detected from the server with holder and requester agent ids and [P] (once per pair per 30 s).
Only agents present in the registry and owned by connected members may be referenced; others are dropped.
scope_out: Reading branch names, heads or paths (encrypted).
build_against: Fake AgentRegistryPort and LockDenialPort emitters, FakeSequencer, fake clock; fixtures contracts/fixtures/events/branch.update.json and conflict.detected.json.
interfaces: BranchHandler.onBranchUpdate(ctx, frame): Promise<Result>  // frame has ct only; never parsed
ConflictSignal.onLockDenied(sid, d:{requesterAgent: AgentId, holderAgent: AgentId, pathHmac: string}): Promise<void>
acceptance: A branch.update frame with a non-empty p, or without ct, is rejected `invalid_frame`; a valid frame is sequenced and fanned out unchanged (ct byte-identical).
5 branch.update frames for one agent within 2 s sequence the first and the last only (latest wins, middle dropped).
conflict.detected whose agent_ids include an unknown agent is rejected `invalid_frame`; one with 201 path_hmacs is rejected (schema max 200).
Same lock denial twice within 30 s produces one server conflict.detected; after 30 s a second one is produced; two different pairs produce two.
Server-originated conflict.detected has `from` = server, includes both agent ids and the single path_hmac, and includes no ct.
A viewer cannot send branch.update or conflict.detected (`forbidden`); in command_post mode only the host may.
No log line or stored record contains ct or p.path_hmacs beyond counters (log scrub test).
guardrails: MUST NOT decrypt, parse or store ct of branch.update.
MUST NOT originate any conflict signal that includes information beyond agent ids and path_hmacs.
Dropped (coalesced) branch.update frames MUST NOT be acked as sequenced; sender is told nothing and does not retry (they are advisory).
MUST NOT use branch or conflict signals to block any other frame.
failure_modes: Registry port unavailable -> pass-through frames with unverified agent ids are rejected with 503-class sys.error, branch.update still passes.
Burst of denials (1 000/s) -> signal rate capped to 10 conflict.detected per session per second, rest counted and dropped.
notes: CONTRACT GAP: the contract sequences every branch.update and does not allow dropping events, so the 1-per-2-s coalescing here is a lane choice that contract owners should confirm; if rejected, remove the rate limit and keep only the 30 s conflict de-dup. LockDenialPort is satisfied by B059 at integration time (no depends_on edge).
